name: session-ownership-doc
title: Adopt session-ownership-and-write-leases.md as a process truth source
description: Docs-only story. The session ownership / write-lease design doc (docs/requirements/decisions/session-ownership-and-write-leases.md) currently exists only as an untracked working-tree file. This story commits it into the repo and integrates it into Koala's decision/truth-source corpus so agents and scope-plan reviewers treat it as authoritative — WITHOUT implementing any of the described runtime behavior (owner lease, main write lock, takeover UX). Implementation is tracked as a separate later story. No core behavior change; only documentation is committed and cross-referenced.
